1. Solve the following equations.
2. The table below shows the heights of 40 students in a Grade 10 class.
(a) Write down the modal class. [1]
(b) Calculate an estimate of the mean height. [4]
(c) Find the probability that a student chosen at random is at least 165 cm tall. [2]
3. A water tank in the shape of a cylinder has a radius of 1.2 m and a height of 2.5 m.
(a) Calculate the volume of the tank in cubic metres. [3]
(b) Water flows out of the full tank at 15 litres per minute. How long, in hours and minutes, does it take to empty? [4]
4. A straight line passes through the points A(−2, 5) and B(4, −7).
(a) Find the gradient of AB. [2]
(b) Find the equation of the line AB in the form y = mx + c. [2]
(c) Find the coordinates of the midpoint of AB. [2]
5. A shop increases the price of a jacket by 20% and later reduces the new price by 15%.
(a) The original price was $80. Find the final price. [3]
(b) Find the overall percentage change in price. [2]
6. In triangle PQR, PQ = 8 cm, QR = 11 cm and angle PQR = 52°.
(a) Calculate the length of PR. [4]
(b) Calculate the area of triangle PQR. [3]
